from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.invoice import average_unit_price
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem

# empty invoice
print("empty:", average_unit_price(Invoice("i","c")))
# half-up case: (1*0.01 + 1*0.02)/2 = 0.015 -> 0.02 (banker's would give 0.02 too)
# use 0.005 -> 0.01 half-up, banker's 0.00
inv = Invoice("i","c", lines=[LineItem("a",1,Decimal("0.005"))])
print("half-up 0.005:", average_unit_price(inv))
# weighted
inv = Invoice("i","c", lines=[LineItem("a",2,Decimal("10.00")), LineItem("b",1,Decimal("4.00"))])
print("weighted:", average_unit_price(inv))
EOF"}
